Re: Herships v. Niemier, et al.; Caldwell v. Niemier, et al.
Dear Honorable Judge:
Enclosed please find a copy of our letter of October 22, 2002 to plaintiff Alma Jean Caldwell
along with our Proposed Orders on Defendants’ Demurrer and Motion to Strike Portions of
Plaintiff Alma Jean Caldwell’s Second Amended Complaint. As we have not heard from Ms.
Caldwell in response to this correspondence, we are now forwarding you the Proposed
Orders for your signature.
If you should have any questions or concerns regarding this correspondence, please do not
hesitate to contact our office.
Very truly yours,
[Dictated but not read]
Joshua S. Goodman

. Dear Ms. Caldwell: -
Enclosed are Proposed Orders reflecting today’s rulings on defendants’ demurrer to the fifth
and ninth causes of action in your second amended complaint and defendants’ motion to
strike portions of your second amended complaint. If these meet with your approval, please
sign them, approving them as to form, and return them to my office. I will then submit them
to the court and thereafter serve you with the respective notices of entry of order as soon as |
. have them.
If we do not receive your endorsement of these proposed orders by October 28, 2002, we will
_ send them, as they are, to Judge Robertson.
Very truly yours,
